info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Servicing Servicing Mandate-spec
info.description: This API allows users to initiate and manage servicing mandates within the banking ecosystem. By leveraging this functionality, financial institutions can streamline their operations, ensuring that customers' servicing requests are efficiently processed. Primary resources include creating new servicing mandates and updating existing records. Typical consumers include banking operations teams and customer service representatives who require effective tools for handling client servicing needs. This API enhances operational efficiency and supports better client engagement.

post.description: This operation allows the user to create a new servicing mandate, which outlines the terms and conditions under which servicing activities will be conducted. The request must include all necessary details as specified in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update a servicing mandate. It should include all necessary information for the operation, specified in the JSON format defined by the schema.

201.description: The servicing mandate was successfully created.
